registration_phase: Before new real-source candidate computation; existing H000 known-answer baseline already public
hypothesis: On the known LP2/56 page, the prime-minus-one clock spans line, title/body and literal hash boundaries while consuming only non-exception runes.

parameters.formula: P=(C-(prime[t]-1)) mod29; first prime at t=0 is 2
parameters.skip_semantics: Copy rune ordinal 56 unchanged and do not advance clock; fixed during inverse encryption too
parameters.title_basis: Five red title runes at ordinals 0..4; first master clause marker at source_offset 7; image and source Red Text agree. Reset before source_offset 8 / rune ordinal 5, not after a whole visual line.
parameters.semicolon_interpretation: Included explicitly in delimiter-consume branch as a tested convention; its source delimiter meaning remains unresolved
parameters.formatting_semantics: All whitespace ignored by clock; every non-rune preserved byte-for-byte in UTF-8 output

branches.rule: Initialize t=0 once; only non-skipped runes advance
Reset t=0 after each raw slash; effective next-rune reset ordinals 20,39,45,67; keep repeated hash-line events
Reset t=0 after each raw ampersand; offsets65 and205 both precede the next rune45, so boundary events are observationally redundant
Reset t=0 once, immediately before source_offset8
Continuous plus one extra advance for each ASCII hex character within the five fixed hash spans; preserve those characters
Continuous plus one extra advance for each raw character in the fixed punctuation set; ignore hash literals and whitespace

parameters.cross_page_continuity: Not tested; one known page only

scorer: None; exact reference rune comparison only
success: Per branch: all85 reference runes agree, non-runes remain unchanged, independent arithmetic trace agrees, and inverse encryption with the same frozen skip/clock convention returns the exact original raw text
failure: A completed branch with reference mismatches is negative only for this input and fixed convention; save total mismatches and first mismatch ordinal/source offset. Exceptions are error, timeouts are timeout, insufficient verification is inconclusive.
expectation_source: Existing reference_indices built from the source Plaintext Latin alternatives and ciphertext word rune counts, never Cleaned up Plaintext; reference construction must remain outside the candidate transform module
independence_limits: Key recipe, skip and known plaintext share ibot73.md. Arithmetic and reference algorithms can be independent; neither cross-repository rune equality nor this audit proves historical source independence.
aliases: continuous aliases H001 documented skip/no-consume and existing H000 baseline; do not count as independent discovery
Repeated resets without an intervening consuming event have the same next-rune effect; retain event trace without double-counting evidence
